Website describes a mural agency with a Mural Academy program for schools, matching OUSD's 'Classroom & academic programs' category and Prop 28 Arts and Music funding

research.notes: No registry record (CA Secretary of State, SAM.gov) was found, so legal name, entity number and headquarters are unconfirmed. The phone number is a 619 (San Diego area) number shown in the website footer. The website says the company began in Orange County; Irvine is not confirmed as its headquarters.

profile.summary: Influential Walls is an educational mural agency. It connects muralists to schools, educational organizations and brands, and runs a Mural Academy program in which students learn to paint large murals and how to build an art business. It was formerly called Disorganized Depictions and was founded in 2019.

review.notes: The organization's site lists Castlemont High (OUSD) among its mural case studies and describes a Mural Academy and school murals, matching the agenda item and the Prop 28 arts funding. The summary, orgType, website and footer phone are supported by the cited pages, and the profile claims no headquarters.
